text: In the Paris Opera House of the 1890s, the young singer Christine Daaé is tutored by a hidden voice that demands she replace the prima donna, and when Carlotta defies it [a chandelier falls onto the audience|threat|people who kill]. Beneath the stage, Erik declares his love and, once Christine [tears off his mask|images|dolls, masks and likenesses], makes her [his prisoner in the depths|wants|a lover to possess]. Her sweetheart Raoul follows a secret door behind her mirror into a lair of heat, gunpowder and [rising water|images|water and drowning].
